name: [Patient 0413]
fragments: Arrived at the front entrance unaccompanied. No identification provided.
Vitals normal. Responds to questions. !!Does not remember the address.!!
Settled in room without resistance.
Has been observed reading other patients' files. ~~Staff have not interrupted.~~ Staff have not been able to.
subtitle: Admitted [[8]] · file open

name: [Father, present]
fragments: Subject occupies the room as if it remains his.
Family report he has been deceased since ~~1986~~ longer.
Daughters visit. He **knows their names**.
He addresses the chair across from him. The chair is empty.
subtitle: He still presides.

name: [Still hungry]
fragments: Subject has consumed everything offered. She continues to ask.
Found chewing on the bedframe. ~~Iron filings~~ flecks recovered from her mouth.
Asked when she was last full. !!She does not remember being.!!
Has begun on the walls of the day room.
subtitle: She has not stopped eating since admission.

name: [Only one home]
fragments: Subject was located on the porch. Smoke damage minor.
Patient was eight. The rest of the family was indoors.
Refers to her brother in present tense. ~~**I** answer when she calls.~~
She has been describing the bedroom upstairs to staff.
subtitle: The rest of the family was indoors.

name: [Walked here from [[6]]]
fragments: Subject was observed approaching the entrance for [[3]] days.
She walked the length of the road. The road is not paved.
Has not sat down since admission. ~~Refuses.~~ Cannot.
Other patients refer to her as the one they came in with.
subtitle: She did not stop when staff approached.

name: [Door he opened]
fragments: Subject sits with one ear toward the corridor.
Patient was a property surveyor. He insists the door was already open.
Asked what was beyond. ~~He described it.~~ The page is missing.
He has begun to listen to the staff lounge through the wall.
subtitle: He says it was already open.

name: [Tucks them in at night]
fragments: Patient was a night nurse for ~~thirty~~ thirty-eight years.
Found in other patients' rooms after lights-out. She does not turn the door handle.
Patients she has tended report **sleeping better**. They do not wake all the way.
Has been seen at staff handover. She is not on the roster.
subtitle: Other patients have stopped reporting it.

name: [Brother came back wrong]
fragments: Subject was returned to family after [[5]] missing.
The brother says it is him. The brother is sure.
Does not eat what the family eats. ~~Will not.~~ Does not appear to need to.
Answers to the brother's name. !!Answers also to his own.!!
subtitle: His brother insists it is him.

name: [Keeps leaving]
fragments: Patient has attempted to leave the ward seventeen times this week.
Each attempt ends in the east hallway. She does not remember the others.
Asked where she was going. Answered: !!the same place she came from.!!
She tells staff her destination differently each time.
subtitle: She is found in the same hallway each time.

name: [Husband kept her]
fragments: Subject was wrapped in linens when delivered to admissions.
Patient's husband brought it in. He has been here since.
He asks after it daily. We tell him she is ~~comfortable~~ kept.
Staff have been instructed not to remove the binding.
subtitle: He brought it in himself. We took it from him.

name: [Asks about the pond]
fragments: Patient asks staff about the pond on the grounds. There is no pond.
She specifies a ~~stone~~ statue at the edge. None on file.
Family report she put **something** in a pond, once. They will not say what.
She names the something. Each time differently.
subtitle: There is no pond on the grounds.

name: [Shell that answers]
fragments: Subject responds when called by her given name.
No further verbal output observed in [[3]] months.
Family ask if she is still in there. We **say yes**.
She has begun to answer questions staff have not yet asked.
subtitle: She responds to her name. Nothing else.

name: [Froze waiting]
fragments: Patient was located on the bench outside the train station.
She had been there since her ~~husband~~ son said he would come.
Her hands have not warmed since. **Staff do not hold them long.**
She still checks her watch.
subtitle: She was found on the bench after.

name: [What the basement is for]
fragments: Subject is housed below the main wards by request. Not hers.
Staff entering the lower level are required to ~~sign out~~ pair up.
She has not been observed eating. The orderlies are losing weight.
She has stopped asking to come up. !!Staff have not stopped asking her to.!!
subtitle: Staff are reminded not to go down.

name: [On the waiting list]
fragments: Patient has been awaiting transfer to [[7]] since 1981.
She does not ask after it. She knows the number she is.
When called by another's name, she ~~corrects~~ accepts it.
Has begun to refer to herself by the number of the room next door.
subtitle: She has been waiting since 1981.

name: [Keeps opening it]
fragments: Subject has reopened the same wound eleven times.
The bandage is replaced daily. She thanks staff. She **cannot help.**
When asked why, she answered: ~~it is healing wrong~~ it is healing.
Something is taking up residence in the opening.
subtitle: Staff have stopped re-stitching.

name: [Moved overnight]
fragments: Patient has not initiated movement since 1972.
Subject was in bed at 22:00. Subject was at the window at 06:00.
Staff present that night ~~do not~~ will not say.
The window faces the staff parking. Several have moved house.
subtitle: He has been still since 1972.

name: [Crawled the length of the hall]
fragments: Subject is fully ambulatory. Refuses to walk.
Patient was found in the south corridor. She had crawled from the east. **It took the night.**
When stood up by orderlies, she ~~sits~~ lowers herself.
Other patients have begun to do the same.
subtitle: She refuses to use the legs.

name: [Garden in him]
fragments: Subject is observed cultivating something within the wound.
He prunes it. He calls it by !!plant names!!.
Smells of [[8]] when the room is closed.
He has begun to ask for water for it.
subtitle: He says it is **growing in nicely**.

name: [Do not reach in]
fragments: Patient is small. She is mostly compliant.
Three orderlies have lost ~~fingers~~ partial use of the right hand.
She apologizes after. !!It does not appear to help her.!!
The compliance is part of the trouble.
subtitle: Three orderlies. So far.

name: [Cannot remember names]
fragments: Patient cannot recall the name of ~~her daughter~~ the one she came in with.
She has been told the room next door is empty. She continues to thank the staff for *the visits*.
When asked her own name, she gave the orderly's. ~~**I** told her it was hers.~~
She has begun to know whose names not to say.
subtitle: She is sure she had a daughter.

name: [Took the notes]
fragments: Patient was a records clerk for thirty-one years.
He continues to take notes. The page is blank.
Staff have begun to !!find their words!! in his hand.
Several of his pages are missing. They are in other files.
subtitle: He used to work in records.

name: [Firstborn]
fragments: Patient is the eldest of [[3]].
His mother is housed two doors down. She does not know him.
He was named after his ~~grandfather~~ uncle. The uncle is also here.
He has begun to introduce himself by his brother's name.
subtitle: His mother is also here.

name: [Shines through her gown]
fragments: Subject emits visible light from the chest cavity.
Lights in her ward are kept dim. ~~For her~~ for the staff.
Family ask what is in there. We have **not** said.
She has begun to read by it.
subtitle: Staff use less light in her ward.

name: [Dog that did not]
fragments: Patient was eight when it ran into the road.
He watched. The rest of the family looked away. He ~~has not~~ cannot stop.
Subject sits at his feet. He pets it. **It has been forty years.**
It has begun to follow him out of the room.
subtitle: He was eight. He doesn't blink.

name: [Heard us]
fragments: Patient occupies the room nearest the staff lounge.
He has begun returning to staff what they spoke of yesterday.
He uses our names. !!We are not sure when he learned them.!!
Two staff have transferred. One has not arrived at the new ward.
subtitle: He has been quoting us back.

name: [Thing in the closet]
fragments: Patient sealed it in his bedroom closet for thirty-six years.
At admission it was smaller than a fist. !!It has grown since.!!
He calls it by ~~his wife's~~ the name they would have given.
He no longer asks staff to keep it in the closet. !!The closet is here.!!
subtitle: He kept it. Quiet. Mostly.

name: [Arrived after [[6]]]
fragments: Subject was logged at the front desk after hours.
Whoever brought her did not sign in. They left her in the chair.
She refuses to identify them. ~~Or cannot.~~ The chair is !!still warm!!.
She has begun to sign in for herself. The handwriting is the orderly's.
subtitle: Whoever brought her did not sign in.

name: [Surviving twin]
fragments: Patient was admitted alone. She insists she is the other one.
Her sister's death certificate is on file. ~~Her~~ the patient's signature is on it.
When asked who she is, she answers her sister's name. !!Each time. The same.!!
Staff have begun to greet her as the sister.
subtitle: She insists she is the other one.

name: [House that visits her]
fragments: Patient draws the same house every morning. Same windows. Same number on the door.
She insists it ~~comes~~ has come for her.
The address she gave matches no facility on record. The house !!is at the address!!.
Other patients have begun to mention the house. They have not seen her drawings.
subtitle: She draws it on the wall every morning.
